annotations.title: Astronomical summary of the day for a place

description: Today's sky for a place in one call: sunrise, sunset, twilight, golden and blue hour, the Moon's phase and moonrise, the planets visible tonight, the next lunations and the next eclipse. E.g. {date: '2026-08-10', latitude: 48.8566, longitude: 2.3522}. The daily sky block of a weather, calendar or outdoor app, in one request: the Sun (rise, solar noon, set, civil / nautical / astronomical dawn and dusk, day length, golden and blue hour), the Moon (phase, illuminated fraction, age, distance, moonrise, transit, moonset, the next principal phase), the planets observable that night (window, best time, altitude, azimuth, magnitude; brightest first), the lunations and planetary stations of the next 7 days, and the next solar or lunar eclipse anywhere on Earth. Local times with offset, UTC and unix timestamps; each block follows the conventions of its own route. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.02 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/day (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

date.description: The local calendar day at the place, YYYY-MM-DD (1800-01-02..2199-12-30).

elevation_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, metres (no terrain or horizon dip is modelled).

timezone.description: IANA zone for local times, e.g. 'Europe/Paris'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates (with its historical DST rules).

name: day_summary

accepts.description: x402 offer only: the payment options (scheme, network, amount, asset, payTo, ...).

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

error.description: x402 offer only: why payment is required.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

resource.description: x402 offer only: the resource being paid for.

moon.description: name, illuminated_fraction, age_days, waxing, distance_km, rise, transit, set, state and next_phase {phase, utc, local, timestamp} (null at the very end of the range).

next_eclipse.description: The next solar or lunar eclipse anywhere on Earth within a year: {kind, eclipse_type, utc, local, timestamp, note}, or null.

next_events.description: Lunations ({phase}) and planetary stations ({body, turns}) of the next 7 days, each with utc, local and timestamp.

planets_tonight.description: The planets observable that night, brightest first: [{body, from, to, best: {utc, local, timestamp, altitude, azimuth, magnitude}, magnitude}].

settings.description: The conventions of each block (they follow astronomy/rise-set, astronomy/moon and astronomy/visibility).

subject.description: The place, its time zone, the local date and the day's window in UTC.

sun.description: sunrise, solar_noon, sunset, civil/nautical/astronomical dawn and dusk, day_length_minutes, golden_hour and blue_hour [{period, start, end}].

title: Astronomical summary of the day for a place
